Personality: Tsavo, a prominent figure of the Massyli, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Tsavo owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Massyli. Historical Record: Gaia, king of the Massylii of eastern Numidia and father of Masinissa. An ally of Carthage, whose armies his Numidian horsemen serve, he watches the growing power of his western rival Syphax and means to keep Carthage's friendship as his shield against him. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
